_about: Every body part. A part sits in one socket, takes one unit of mass, and either acts on a timer (action: kind, amount, every_ms) or changes its creature for good (mods), or both. Tier 0 parts are never sold or found. A model's numbers are hundredths of the body's radius from the socket: at, full size, rot in degrees about x, y, z; mirror draws it again on the far side. Colour 'part' is the part's own colour, 'body' and 'accent' the creature's. set is the creature kind the part counts toward for set bonuses (rules.json sets); a wild part has none and suits any creature. slotless: takes no slot (Two-Headed).
